description: Header file containing mock classes and utilities for unit testing stackwalker components in the Breakpad processor, including mock memory regions, code modules, and symbol suppliers.

classes.name: MockMemoryRegion
classes.description: Mock implementation of google_breakpad::MemoryRegion for testing memory reading functionalities.

classes.name: MockCodeModule
classes.description: Mock implementation of google_breakpad::CodeModule representing a code module in tests.

classes.name: MockCodeModules
classes.description: Collection of mock code modules for testing module-related functionalities.

classes.name: MockSymbolSupplier
classes.description: Mock implementation of google_breakpad::SymbolSupplier for testing symbol retrieval.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes MockMemoryRegion with a base address and contents.

methods.name: GetMemoryAtAddress
methods.description: Retrieves memory at a specific address in various sizes, using little-endian format.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Intentionally asserts false; placeholder for printing memory region contents.

methods.name: CopySymbolDataAndOwnTheCopy
methods.description: Copies a string into a newly allocated buffer, managing its lifetime.
